description: Refresh skills-npm-lock.json after skills-npm or @inthememory/agent-config upgrades when the lockfile is present at the repo root

packageRules.description: When skills-npm or @inthememory/agent-config is upgraded and skills-npm-lock.json exists at the repo root, re-sync skills so the lock and .agents/skills links match the new package versions. Renovate only updates the lockfile, so dependencies are installed first: skills-npm discovers skills in node_modules.

commands: if [ -f skills-npm-lock.json ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm exec skills-npm --force --yes; fi
